**CVE-2026-137043 - TOTOLINK N350RT authorization bypass (CVSS 9.3).** A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
